reason: Release 38: #1992 (claude/mesh-fix-step0): Mesh creatures on by default (Ed, 2026-11-12: "meshes are great, we should aim to transition to them for all the creatures"; docs/plans/creature-meshes.md): home's kinds are drawn from low-poly meshes on skeletons (art/mesh), at the sizes Ed passed, on eight-frame walks, and the live rig no longer draws them. And the bee takes the marten's place on home with an id of its own (Ed, 2026-11-11: "swap the marten for the bee"; 2026-11-12: "make a new ID, keep the marten distinct", "marten is on the bench", "It flies."): wherever the rosters dealt a marten they deal a bee, a flier that moves as the moth does and fights as the marten did. And the turtle takes the newt's place in the Fen the same way (Ed, 2026-11-12: "newt for turtle"): slower, armoured, fighting as the newt did. Carried forward from #1962 on claude/mesh-fix-step0, with the fixes from Ed's playtest of them (2026-11-12: "animals appear to float above the ground"; "they appear to vibrate along instead of walk"; "many small creatures bound rather than trot"): each mesh kind stands on its sprite's bottom row, its legs stride (a walk of eight frames stepped by a stride measured at the paw, at most 20 frames a second), a kind goes by its own gait (trot, bound, walk, glide, fly), and it stands on a ninth, standing frame when it stops; and step 0 of docs/plans/creature-mesh-rollout.md, which moves each kind's mesh to its own file and draws nothing differently. And, from Ed's look at the walk clip (2026-11-12: "the feet don't plant, and the bodies seem rigid"; sizes "from the height actually drawn, not the canvas size"): a legged mesh kind's feet are planted for their stance (its legs solved from the paw), its body moves with its gait, it has a slow pace and a fast one (seventeen frames a heading in place of nine: its sprites are taller for the run's leap and its atlas about twice the size), the view draws it in whole steps with its frames (up to a step behind where it is) with no cap on frames a second, it stops on a frame of its walk, and what sizes it in the view (its health bar's height, its hops) is its drawn standing height.

rules.*: every night whose roster held the marten or the newt: bees in the marten's place (the flier trait, the moth's steering, a smaller body radius, its own waiting pattern) and turtles in the newt's (slower, armoured, another body radius and waiting pattern), and whatever follows from where they go

frames.*: wherever one of home's kinds or the turtle is in view: its new drawing, its size, where it stands on the ground, its walk's frames and how fast they pass, and its standing frame; a bee wherever a marten was, a turtle wherever a newt was; and each legged mesh kind's walk and run frames, where it is drawn along its way (up to a step behind), the frame it stops on, and what hangs over it by its height
